'''6E-O3''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that sold gear to the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] forces while stationed on [[CZ-198]], during the time of the [[Galactic War]] between the Sith Empire and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Its droid model was similar in function and appearance to [[Imperial DroidWorks]]' [[Seneschal-series factotum droid]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=location|Office Terminal 1-A|[[CZ-198]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
6E-O3 was first added as a Reputation Vendor to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.3. The droid was later removed in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]].
